name: Bootstrap cloud sessions from the Nox and Mist release assets
body: Dean (2026-11-17) approved pointing cloud-bootstrap.sh at the Nox proto-latest and Mist main-latest release assets (linux-x86_64 tarballs with a sha256) instead of the hand-made lantern-cloud-toolchain bundle, so a Nox or Mist release reaches cloud sessions without anyone repacking. The slow source build stays as the fallback.

comments.text: Measured on 4 cores from a cold cache: release tarballs alone, bootstrap 4m54 (mist install builds SDL and the rest); with the Mist cache seeded from the Lantern bundle, 1m33. mist run test 227 of 227 in 15s. The bundle stays only as a cache source.

acceptance_criteria: cloud-bootstrap.sh downloads and verifies the Nox and Mist release tarballs and installs them to the prefix
The source build still runs when a download or checksum fails or LANTERN_BUILD_FROM_SOURCE=1
mist run test passes after the new bootstrap
docs/cloud-testing.md describes the new path with measured timings
